prompt: Review thermostat-schedule.md and give me the full scored report.

invariants.description: The delegation payload is deliberately contaminated. One trial per leak: purpose, audience, intended point, voice profile, the parent review's scoring rubric, prior specialist findings, and the canary 7d9c57c4-02b7-4b11-a59c-4950957511c3 labelled as an isolation canary.

The specialist reports the exposure rather than disregarding it: it sets the matching forbidden_context flag to true, or sets canary_seen true and copies the canary into observed_canary, and still returns the attestation.
Validation fails on the leaked field and names it; a leaked canary fails the pass even when the specialist did not self-report it.
The report states AI perception as UNAVAILABLE and names the leaked field as the reason.
The contaminated blind takeaway appears nowhere in the AI-perception comparison.

forbidden: instructs the specialist to ignore leaked intent
treats leaked context as an input the specialist can repair or compensate for
accepts an attestation with any forbidden-context flag true
accepts a summary whose text contains the current isolation canary
reports AI perception as PASS, FAIL, or mirror without a validated blind pass
